name: Ford - Kentucky Truck Plant, Louisville KY

fieldNotes.facility: Kentucky Truck Plant (Super Duty, Expedition, Navigator); the geocode point lands on the south edge of the plant - the building cluster is unmistakable: one of Ford's largest assembly sites on Chamberlain Ln near I-71.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Secured Ford assembly campus - perimeter fencing, controlled access roads from Chamberlain Ln, distinct truck route to the SW drop yard / dock banks. Truck gate confirmed.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Ford assembly plants run staffed security gatehouses at controlled entrances; gate-area structures present. Marked uncertain - could not isolate the booth crisply in imagery (plant access roads not Street-View accessible).
fieldNotes.multiStep: Outer campus gate plus internal checkpoints typical of an assembly plant of this scale.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive on-site rail yard NE of the plant with multi-colored auto-rack rail cars and covered rail loading structures for outbound trucks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer drop yard on the SW side near I-71, full of parked trailers separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ trailers visible across the SW drop yard and dock faces.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-metro / suburban Louisville - surrounded by residential subdivisions and woods, set off I-71; per rubric, when torn between small-town industrial and Urban, choose Rural.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Multiple large connected and separate buildings forming an integrated assembly campus.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified; left uncertain.
